name: Hierarchical Raster Occlusion Culling
aliases: Hierarchical Raster Occlusion Culling (Lee et al.)
Lee et al. [LJSL21] hierarchical raster occlusion culling
definition: A fully GPU-driven hierarchical raster occlusion culling algorithm that reduces overall rasterization overhead by performing rasterization on a coarser level for group nodes, and refining visibility results through ray traversal down to the leaf level.
